correctness.rationale: For K_n with k disjoint marked edges priced P, others Q, convert budgeted lambda_2 maximization by homogeneity into unit-gap L>=Pi cost minimization. X_s=Pi(1/2 I+(1-s)/2 A_M)Pi is PSD on 1-perp exactly up to rc=2 for k>=2, and rc=2(n-1)/(n-2) for k=1. Its edge quadratic lengths are s on matched edges, 1 otherwise, with trace (n-1)/2+k(s-1)/n, a universal dual price lower bound. Uniform weights 1/n attain below threshold; X_r positive definite forces L=Pi hence unique weights. Explicit zero-matching designs attain the critical bound and have all nonzero eigenvalues at least 1. Strict dual slack at r>rc forces deletion of all marked edges in EVERY optimizer; equal-cost boundary solutions and convex combinations follow. Independent 79 matching-deletion configurations and 186 projected-dual configurations checked spectrum, costs and lengths. No claim about arbitrary nonmatching priced edges.
